title: Final Energy Difference
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final energy difference of 1.11 x 10^-2 eV.

title: Correct Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly use the rotational energy level formula E_J = (hbar^2 / 2I) J(J + 1).

title: Moment of Inertia
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the moment of inertia I correctly using I = mu * r^2.

title: Mass Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately calculate the reduced mass mu for the HD molecule.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy difference calculation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing factors in the moment of inertia or energy difference calculations.
